hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate F(theta)=polygamma(0,theta) at theta=z for the first member. Apply d/dtheta to F(theta) and instantiate at theta=z to obtain the second member. The raw expression is the sum of these two operator images.
hypotheses.rationale: The two terms are consecutive polygamma orders; the order-1 polygamma is the derivative of the order-0 digamma, so the expression is the value of (I + D) on polygamma(0,z).

hypotheses.construction_plan: Evaluate the two-parameter polygamma family P(n,theta)=polygamma(n,theta) at n=0 and n=1 with theta=z. The raw expression is the sum of these two specializations.
required_assumptions: polygamma(n,theta) is defined for integer n >= 0
hypotheses.rationale: Both terms are instances of the same named function with different integer order parameter n, so they form a two-point specialization of the polygamma family.
